## Project memory and Git publication

- Project memory is opt-in. Do not read, update, or checkpoint it unless the owner invokes `$maintain-project-memory`.
- Exception: when the owner explicitly requests a commit, push, or PR action, read only the [Git publication ownership rules](memory/RULES.md#git-publication-ownership) before acting.

## BK7258 trust safety

- During active BK7258 work, do not use N17 or another historical trust domain as a source, baseline, key candidate, or fallback unless the owner explicitly reactivates it.
- A maintained signing identity is referenced explicitly by its public fingerprint and an approved secure local path, secret-manager, or HSM reference. Do not generate, rotate, destroy, print, or place private key material in the repository, logs, or temporary automation unless the owner explicitly authorizes that identity operation.
- A missing private signing key blocks only the signing/release step. It does not block source review, configuration, ordinary incremental builds, host regression, or unsigned diagnostic artifacts; state the blocked signing input precisely.
- Reuse unchanged boot components and sealed signed artifacts when content,
  configuration, toolchain, trust identity, protected metadata and dependencies
  still match. Use the existing CP/AP OTA signing path without re-signing BL1/BL2.
  A changed version, counter, TLV or pair dependency invalidates the affected
  signed artifact; a matching raw payload alone does not establish reuse.
- Before any full download, the target preflight must match its accepted base generation and the signed package must pass its own trust and rollback checks. Record the signer reference and public identity in release evidence, never a private path or value. The apps-only path remains bound to its installed public trust contract and exact target fingerprint.
- Backup scope follows the actual erase/write or migration scope. The current AIDK 8-MiB full-image path needs trusted same-device base material, but may reuse an accepted historical full-device readback when its hash and device identity match. The CLI requiring a complete base file is an interface condition, not a demand to reacquire it for every write. A configuration rollback needs explicit owner authorization; if non-reconstructible data has no trustworthy same-device material, refuse the operation. Never copy a target-bound image or device-unique data to another unit.

## BK7258 hardware-first debugging

- Active BK7258 bring-up and adaptation defaults to hardware-fast mode.  State
  `current mode: hardware-fast iteration` once at the start, then keep updates
  short and action-oriented.  Context compaction or a new session must not
  silently return the task to final-acceptance mode.
- In hardware-fast mode, follow the shortest useful loop: use the current board
  log to select one evidence-based hypothesis, make the smallest correctly
  layered change, incrementally build only the affected target, perform only
  the minimum image-integrity check, and hand off the directly flashable
  artifact immediately.  Real-board results are the acceptance signal for the
  iteration.
- Stop a short loop when the stated observation either confirms or rejects its
  single hypothesis, then report the next bounded question. Do not keep adding
  probes, broad regression, clean builds, signing, or key work after that stop
  condition without a new reason.
- Use mechanical tools for repeatable file, config, build and artifact facts.
  Give a model only the compact hypothesis, relevant evidence, changed owner,
  stop condition, and the affected tests; do not make it reconstruct unrelated
  logs or run a generic full-workspace review.
- A debug-artifact handoff is not a final project handoff.  Defer broad host
  regression, unrelated-board clean builds, documentation and provenance
  audits, official-checkout audits, ZIP/release assembly and other final
  acceptance work until the task includes that final delivery and the relevant
  hardware path passes. Do not introduce speculative tests merely to delay the
  next hardware attempt.
- Mandatory device-data and trust protections still apply.  If an iteration
  requires a whole-device BIN, perform only the minimum required accepted-base,
  signer-reference, signature, rollback and exact-Flash-size checks, then hand
  off the BIN without unrelated gates or a ZIP.  Prefer the installed apps-only path
  when its existing trust contract permits the affected CP/AP update.
- Passing the requested hardware observation completes that iteration; it does
  not add final acceptance or release work to the task. Continue any remaining
  authorized iterations. Enter final-acceptance mode only when the current task
  includes final acceptance or release, and apply only its matching handoff gates.

## BK7258 validation tiers

- Ordinary code/config increment: build only the affected role/target and run its directly
  relevant host or target regression. Reuse the established build tree and
  signing identity; neither `--clean` nor signing is a default validation step.
- Impacted regression: run the tests and builds selected by changed ownership
  (chip/common changes include affected board profiles; board wiring stays on
  that board). State why each selected test is relevant and what remains out of
  scope.
- Before adding a test or probe, state the current behavior or hypothesis it
  checks, why existing coverage is insufficient, and how its result changes the
  next action. Reuse the existing harness; stop expansion at the acceptance point.
- Boot/trust/layout change: run the dedicated clean, package, signature,
  rollback, readback and boot evidence path. This is an explicit specialist
  workflow, not a gate for ordinary app or driver increments.
- Documentation-only changes need format and affected-link review, not firmware
  builds or application tests. Reuse passing checks while their inputs remain
  unchanged.

## BK7258 delegation boundaries

- Follow the user-level T0–T3 routing policy. Hardware/Flash/trust, release,
  chip/board and AP/CP decisions remain owned by the current root agent.
- UART/debug/download access, a board build tree and a GPU training run are
  exclusive resources. Child agents may collect bounded logs, hashes,
  manifests, symbols and configuration evidence; the root chooses the
  hypothesis and owns each hardware-fast iteration and acceptance decision.

## BK7258 architecture

- Before redesigning legacy public entry points or domain ownership, define the target commands, ownership, authoritative mutable facts and deletion set. Resolve material architecture gaps before implementing that redesign; a narrow fix need not invent a complete redesign plan.
- Historical scripts, schemas, tests, and documents are evidence, not requirements. Preserve behavior only when a current build, package, verification, or hardware path consumes it; do not create one-file compatibility moves.
- `tools/bk7258/bk7258.py` is the only tracked public entry; domain implementation belongs under `_lib`. Consult its help for command syntax and the maintained build/package SOP for the requested workflow.
- The team manifest owns SDK/toolchain identity, CP/AP profiles own board/role compatibility, `--boot` is explicit input, and the selected partition CSV owns geometry, topology, roles, and build/write policy.  The board-selected release-policy CSV owns only product update semantics (`replace`, `preserve`, `device-unique`, `transactional`, `factory-init`, `immutable`) and must cover every partition by name without repeating offsets or sizes.  Consumers must not duplicate these facts.
- Descriptor-only board extension applies to the current BK7258 dual-core BL1/BL2 and MCUboot A/B product model.  A different boot/update model requires a separately reviewed product-mode contract; never implement it as a physical-board-name branch or silently reinterpret the current `boot`/`cp`/`ap`/BL2/manifest/`persistent_data` contract.
- For an authorized cleanup, report retired layers and ensure no duplicate public entry, version, profile, path, layout or build-policy owner was introduced. File count alone is not a quality gate.

## Upstream-oriented peripheral drivers

- This rule applies to every external peripheral class, including displays,
  sensors, storage, NFC, audio codecs, chargers, cameras and future devices.
- Before implementing a peripheral driver, search the relevant manifest-pinned
  NuttX/OpenVela trees first. Reuse an existing standard driver and ABI when
  one exists; provide only the missing SoC lower half and board binding.

- When NuttX/OpenVela has no suitable driver, implement the missing driver in

  implementation under the matching `drivers/` class, Kconfig plus CMake and

  independent transport callbacks.  Keep vendor headers, SoC controller
  details, GPIO numbers, power votes and board wiring out of that generic

- Keep SoC transport adaptation in `chips/` and physical instance policy in
  `boards/`.  Preserve the source license and provenance of any protocol or
  initialization sequence derived from a vendor SDK, and structure the generic
  driver so it can be submitted upstream without carrying BK7258/AIDK code.
- In this multi-repository product workspace, keep every new upstream-oriented
  NuttX/OpenVela driver as canonical source under the matching mirrored path in
  this team repository (for example `nuttx/drivers/...` and
  `nuttx/include/...`).  Expose the coherent overlay with one
  directory-level manifest `linkfile`, following the existing `chips/` and
  `boards/` mapping pattern; do not grow per-file mappings or hard-code the
  team checkout path in Kconfig, CMake or Make files.  Consume the mapped
  overlay through NuttX's external/custom integration points and do not edit
  the checked-out official NuttX/OpenVela repositories directly.  Only
  materialize the same overlay as direct upstream-repository changes when the
  owner explicitly requests an upstream patch, commit or PR.

## Test ownership and upstream integration

- The contest repository is the canonical source for every BK7258 test.  Do
  not edit or copy an official OpenVela test runner merely to add this board.
- When adding or changing test integration, use the matching host, CMocka or
  pytest rules in the [test integration SOP](docs/platforms/bk7258/nuttx-port/bk7258-build-flash-debug-sop.md#test-integration).

## Workspace and manifest ownership

- This contest repository is the only writable submission source.  Keep the
  checked-out official NuttX, OpenVela apps, tests, packages and documentation
  projects free of team-owned tracked edits; expose team-owned trees with
  manifest `linkfile` entries instead.
- When changing manifest mappings or application registration, read the
  [workspace integration SOP](docs/platforms/bk7258/nuttx-port/bk7258-build-flash-debug-sop.md#workspace-integration)
  for discovery boundaries and verification of the materialized mapping.
- Keep the repository layers literal: reusable SoC mechanisms in `chips/`,
  physical wiring and instance policy in `boards/`, upstream-shaped overlays
  in `nuttx/`, product apps in `app/`, host tests in `tests/host/`, target
  tests in `app/testing/`, official-runner pytest children in `tests/pytest/`,
  and the sole public BK7258 CLI in `tools/bk7258/`.
- Do not recreate generic `integration/`, `progress/`, top-level
  `vendorsetup.sh`, copied official source/docs, transient review dossiers,
  generated build trees or compatibility wrappers.  A required vendor build
  hook belongs under `boards/<chip>/build/`; generated artifacts belong under
  the workspace output tree and stay untracked.

## Repository synchronization and checkout hygiene

- The manifest pins repository and SDK identities. Synchronize only missing
  task dependencies; use full-manifest sync for full initialization or an
  explicit full-sync request. Before syncing or resolving checkout conflicts,
  read the [synchronization SOP](docs/platforms/bk7258/nuttx-port/bk7258-build-flash-debug-sop.md#repository-synchronization-and-checkout-hygiene).
  Never force-sync, replace the pinned SDK fork, or discard unrelated user work.

## Change economy and maintainability

- Do not add a script for a one-off inspection, a short documented command or
  an alias to an existing tool.  Prefer a direct command for manual work and
  extend `tools/bk7258/bk7258.py` for a durable public workflow.
- A new script is justified only by a real build-system hook, board automation
  boundary or test-runner contract with a named consumer.  Document that
  consumer, keep policy in the existing Python domain modules, and add a
  mechanically verifiable check.  Delete superseded entry points in the same
  change so two scripts never own one workflow.
- A board `scripts/` directory may retain the NuttX-required `Make.defs` build
  hook.  Do not place product build/sign/package/key-broker/deploy workflows
  beside it; those remain commands/domains of the sole BK7258 CLI, while
  unavoidable button/cable operations are documented as manual fixture steps.
- Optimize for human maintenance: use explicit layer names and small cohesive
  modules, avoid generated-looking wrappers and speculative frameworks, and
  do not preserve an obsolete abstraction merely to reduce the apparent diff.

## Chip, board and shared-resource contracts

- BK7258 is one SoC adaptation serving multiple boards.  Put controller,
  interrupt, DMA, clock and cross-core mechanisms in `chips/bk7258/`; put each
  board's pin map, polarity, reset timing, rail hookup and populated-device
  policy in its own `boards/bk7258/<board>/` directory.  `boards/bk7258/common/`
  may contain only behavior genuinely shared by every consuming board; it is
  not a home for panel, sensor or other generic peripheral drivers.
- Keep one stable machine identifier for each physical board across directory,
  Kconfig, manifest, CLI, test and package paths.  Record marketing, schematic
  or colloquial names as documented aliases; never create a second board tree
  or compatibility script merely because the same board has another name.
- Each board `openvela.conf` selects its CP/AP profiles, partition CSV and one
  release-policy CSV.  Partition layout CSVs are maintained in
  `boards/bk7258/common/partitions/bk7258/`; a board directory selects one and
  does not keep a private copy.  Adding a board may add or reuse those declarations but
  must not add a board-name branch to the packaging code.  Flash capacity and
  operator length always come from the selected partition CSV; the release
  policy cannot override geometry.
- Define a chip-wide Kconfig/build requirement once, while every board/profile
  keeps its own explicit defconfig choices.  A configuration fix must be made
  at the narrowest correct owner: shared chip/test contract for all boards,
  board profile for one board, never a copied workaround in three defconfigs.
- Model a physically shared rail, clock or bus as a shared resource.  The chip
  layer may expose a generic module-identity vote/refcount mechanism; the board
  layer maps that resource to its physical GPIO or regulator.  Peripheral
  consumers acquire and release their own votes and must not directly unmap,
  power down or reconfigure a peer's pins or rail.
- Bus protocol belongs to the actual device contract.  Do not retain SPI
  helpers for a UART peripheral, touch optional data pins in one-bit SDIO mode,
  or infer wiring from another board.  Record the schematic-derived mapping in
  the board documentation/config and verify the selected pinmux in the image.
- Apply the handoff policy's board/profile coverage only for requested final
  acceptance. Never claim multi-board support from one successful image.

## Portable paths and build integration

- Follow the official build variables at each layer: prefer `TOPDIR`,
  `APPDIR`, `NUTTX_DIR`, `NUTTX_BOARD_DIR`, `CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR` and named
  repository/board roots.  Resolve a boundary once and derive all cross-tree
  inputs from that named root; do not scatter repeated `../../..` assumptions.
- Never embed `[LOCAL_HOME]`, a team checkout directory name, a Windows user
  path or a remote repository URL as a build dependency.  A single
  script-location-relative root discovery is acceptable at a standalone
  script/test boundary when the official environment provides no root
  variable; downstream paths must still use the resolved root.
- Use compiler include directories and public headers instead of parent-path
  includes in C/C++.  Use the manifest-mapped overlay path derived from
  `NUTTX_DIR`/`TOPDIR`, not the physical contest checkout, when consuming
  team-owned NuttX overlays.
- Do not mechanically replace valid relative paths.  After changing path
  handling, test the supported invocation from outside the source directory
  when applicable and run the affected clean build; portability is an
  observed property, not a spelling rule.

## Documentation structure and lifecycle

- Keep one current truth for mutable state: board/profile support in
  `boards/bk7258/CONFIGS.md`, SoC contracts in `docs/chips/bk7258/`, and the
  platform entry in `docs/platforms/bk7258/README.md`.  Other documents link
  to these sources and must not maintain a second current-status table,
  roadmap or next-stage pointer.
- For documentation edits or cleanup, use the [maintenance rules](docs/README.md#文档维护).
  Moving or deleting a document requires checking its affected incoming links
  and claims, not a whole-repository link or status audit.

## Code style and comment conventions

- Governing style per directory (do not apply one formatter to the whole
  repository):
# 傻妞：外设联动与桌面伙伴

本轮目标：傻妞独立运行、感知动作、实体互动并与电脑协作。
按 N1 动作/表情/有限触觉 → N2 NFC 场景卡/本地内容 →
N3 原生 USB 电脑任务/资源工作台 → 按需摄像头本地采集/电脑取景推进。

2026-10-18 用户明确：OTA 及升级后的重连专项放到最后。继续上述功能顺序，
已完成的真实语音与手机连接验收按对应版本保留，不重新设为功能开发的前置门禁。

当前行为合同见 [桌面伙伴合同](docs/platforms/bk7258/shaniu-desktop-companion.md)。
工作区证据保存在 `../out/shaniu-desktop-20261010/`。本文件不替代源码、
构建身份或实板证据。此前目标和原始证据保留在 Git/原输出目录。

## 约束

- 已授权已连接 AIDK 的正常 HIL、下载和全量烧录；常规迭代保留状态，
  不执行 factory-init、不清 owner/Key/SD/资源，不改变信任和校准数据。
- 不使用过期云套餐或旧 Key，不购买服务，不改变开发 Agent provider。

- 原 KWS、匹配前端、判据、“我在”、默认资源和配置保持。

- 保持原生 Android、标准/工程隔离、QEMU 独立、正式资源所有者。
- 开发仓 `Embracecactus/contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian`；官方 PR
  目标 `open-vela/contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian:dev-ai-contest-2026`。

- USB Audio、UVC/HID、家庭事件和更多小游戏保留后续独立专项。

## 完成口径

M1 完整动作/表情/触觉软件链路及当前可执行实板证据；M2 场景卡、
本地内容、权限与异常闭环；M3 可使用的电脑入口、真实进程示例、
资源流程与 PR；M4 按需采集、传输/取景和退出。
逐项区分主机轨迹、工程输入、真实采样、驱动/LCD 提交、真人体验。

# 傻妞桌面伙伴行为合同

本合同约束动作、有限触觉及其与现有产品服务的连接。实板、版本和
阶段状态只在 `boards/bk7258/CONFIGS.md` 汇总（入口见
[平台事实所有权](README.md#事实所有权)），具体证据保留在日期化验收记录中；
不用注入轨迹表示真人准确率。

## N1 输入与反馈

- 唯一 motion worker 受产品准入控制，采样间隔至少 100 ms；关闭后无自主采样。
  连续准入期间由同一服务保留唯一 sensor 描述符，避免每轮重做激活/配置/关闭。
  失去准入只撤销快照并唤醒原 worker；worker 关闭描述符后才允许静默退出。
  关闭失败保持清理错误，禁止重新采样；取消后重入不能发布旧样本。
  查询只复制一个快照；设备 I/O 仍由 motion 服务串行执行。样本来源为
  AP uORB sensor_accel，时间为该 AP 单调微秒；旧/重复/未来及超过
  250 ms 的样本不产生反馈，间隔超过 250 ms 后重新建立参考。
- 复用动作候选判定：相邻变化 3000 mm/s² 进入移动，稳定区
  500 mm/s²、驻留 400 ms，重力有效区 8000–12000 mm/s²，倾斜
  进入/退出余弦 0.80/0.95。事件冷却 2 s。这是初始行为合同，
  不是拿起/放下、绝对位置或真人手势调参结论。
- 移动、稳定、倾斜只发布最长 800 ms 的缓存表情意图，不读 SD、
  不装包、不持久化默认。认领、电源、显式资源/表情操作、语音、专注
  和任务界面优先；被抢占事件直接作废，恢复当前资源缓存，不补播。
- 专注/任务完成沿同一产品事件路径请求 40 ms 脉冲，2 s 冷却，
  无排队重试。动作本身不振动，避免形成加速度反馈循环。触觉后
  500 ms 丢弃动作参考；说话及收音期间不触发，板级 capture_quiet
  仍是最后保护。OTA、电源关键阶段、健康样本无效/过期、电压
  ≤3400 mV 和电机故障抑制触觉。3400 mV 只是本功能保守抑制线，
  不用于关机、SOC 百分比或续航推断。
- 电机保持现有 GPIO 电平与共享供电投票，不引入 PWM/占空比；
  沿用板级最大 100 ms 和最短停机 1000 ms。退出取消待发脉冲并停止。
- 云凭据和 owner 不属于自主动作准入条件；认领 QR 仍优先显示。
  完成反馈只来自生产服务的实际完成，未知状态保持未知。

## N1 资源预算与证据边界

- 不增加线程、计时器、采集器、播放器或渲染器；沿用 motion、
  haptic、display worker 和产品事件循环。
- motion 新增一个 64 B 快照及有限元数据；产品策略状态预算
  256 B，显示意图元数据预算 64 B。不新增全帧缓存。分段计时元数据
  两份各 20 B，加两个租约布尔量；准入时保留一个原有 sensor 订阅描述符，
  不把该文件/uORB 分配的运行时成本算作零。
- 队列各一个合并槽；产品回调仅元数据操作，不等待传感器/SD/LCD。
  自主采样上限 10 Hz，显示沿既有 100 ms worker 节拍，SD 写入为零。
- 实际常驻/峰值内存、栈与设备 I/O 阻塞时间随候选构建/实板测量；
  未测值不写作实测保证。主机轨迹、真实采样、LCD 提交、驱动返回和
  真人视觉/体感分别验收。

## N2 场景与本地内容

- 复用 MFRC522 现有单卡选择及 500 ms NFC worker。仅现有驱动支持的
  ISO14443A UID 卡作为映射输入；HCE/ISO-DEP 是另一个已有协议，不意味着任意
  NFC 标签/手机兼容。未知、多卡冲突和读取失败不推断移开；可信移开才重新准入。
- 8 个映射槽，NCB1 旧专注时长可读，NCB2 用保留字节显式存 action；1–4 为
  原专注开始/暂停/继续/取消，5 为指定内容播放，6 为取消内容。内容参数仅支持
  ID 1。UID 不成为 owner，也不表达安装、清空设备或任意路径。
- NCF1 保留旧开始专注入口，NCF2 第 12 字节起为 action；NCS2 共 176 B，
  48 B 作业头后每槽 action:u32、reserved:u32、argument:u64，均大端。
  原 owner 认证、版本比较、操作身份、提交边界和取消语义保持。
- NCA2 为 48 B 查询：前 16 B 能力/服务状态；后续为 event:u64、action:u32、
  intent:u32、phase:u32、result:i32、reserved:u64。phase 0/1/2/3/4/5 分别为
  无结果/待执行/实际应用或内容结束/失败/取消/未知。意图受理不等于执行完成。
- 原生 App 设置中的“场景卡片”选择操作、登记、读回；旧固件仍限开始专注。
  一次仅放一张卡，登记后移开再碰卡；驻留不重播。页面关闭不替设备取消。
- 内容 ID 1 为原创四秒“四拍节律”，16 kHz、单声道 PCM16，128000 B；
  只从只读 ROMFS 读取，先验大小/SHA256，再由正式 Media 播放器执行。
  不触及 SD 可写卷，不与 MSC 争写，不替换“我在”。缺失/损坏明确失败。
- 产品 owner 暂停同一 KWS recorder，保留模型和配置；原 outbound worker 播放，
  完成/取消后恢复。语音交互、OTA、电源和 owner 失效优先，未准入不排队重试。
  队列为一个意图，待发最长 2 s，运行预算 8 s，排空最多 2 s；实际 Media
  I/O 及退出耗时仍需测量，不把预算称为硬实时保证。
- 资源预算：ROMFS +128000 B；PCM scratch 640 B，加一个 SHA256 context；
  固定元数据与 8 槽 action 扩展，无新常驻线程、全文件缓存、SD 写入或计时器。
  关闭失败保留清理错误并禁止新播放；电源/重置须等原 Media 清理完成。

#ifndef __APP_BK7258_NATIVE_ABI_H
#define __APP_BK7258_NATIVE_ABI_H

/****************************************************************************
 * Included Files
 ****************************************************************************/

#include <stdint.h>

/****************************************************************************
 * Pre-processor Definitions
 ****************************************************************************/

#define BKNATIVE_ABI 1u
#define BKNATIVE_STATE_MAX 256u

/****************************************************************************
 * Public Types
 ****************************************************************************/

struct bknative_frame_s
{
  /* 0 keeps the current frame; 1 happy, 2 thinking, 3 neutral.
   * Display intents expire within 1..5000 ms and never persist a default.
   */

  uint32_t expression;
  uint32_t duration_ms;
  uint32_t progress;
};

struct bknative_program_s
{
  uint32_t abi;
  uint32_t state_size;
  /* Cooperative callbacks must return promptly without imports, allocation,
   * threads, hardware access or retaining pointers outside their state.
   * start: 0 accepted, negative error.
   * step: 0 active, 1 done, negative error.
   */

  int (*start)(void *state, uint32_t argument);
  int (*step)(void *state, uint32_t elapsed_ms,
              struct bknative_frame_s *frame);
};

typedef const struct bknative_program_s *(*bknative_entry_t)(void);

#endif

`openvela_ap_native_test` is a diagnostic profile. It independently compiles
the fixed breathing example into an ELF fixture. The accepted ownership split
runs all filesystem, RPMsg and ELF lifecycle work on CPU0. One phase executes
the already-loaded import-free callback on CPU1 before CPU0 unloads it. It
also proves that a CPU1 loader attempt is rejected with `-EXDEV` before file
or OpenAMP work. The product native manager applies the same CPU0 gate to
initialize, install, start, step, stop and readback entry points.
The profile neither configures a module publisher nor installs a persistent
feature or starts a remote execution service. It is not a product release
profile; build
success alone does not accept the loader. The normal `openvela_ap` profile
does not launch this automatic test.

Further same-day isolation passed CPU1 thread/yield, CPU0-load/CPU1-call,
and a single CPU1 load/unload. Ordinary CPU1 file I/O also reproduced the
failure, including before any ELF load in the task-mutex comparison; ELF
execution is therefore not required. Frozen RPMsg traces observed premature
loss of ownership of the same `rdev` lock and recursive-count underflow.
The task-mutex comparison also failed and was removed. These are diagnostic
findings, not a fix or permission for CPU1 to perform filesystem or RPMsg
work. A trace-off profile passed 100 CPU0 load/call/unload cycles, plus 100
CPU0-load/CPU1-call/CPU0-unload cycles without a fault or supervisor stall.
The later CPU0-gate candidate additionally rejected the native manager and ELF
loader entry points on CPU1 with `-EXDEV`, then passed the same two 100-cycle
paths. Its serial wrapper reported an evidence-check error only because one
requested expression omitted the intervening `observed=0` field; the complete
capture contains all three PASS records and no configured failure expression.

A separate transport-diagnostic run passed the dedicated-region lock and then
timed out an ordinary internal-SRAM lock while its word read as unlocked. This
is evidence that the lower-layer cross-core lock problem remains intermittent;
it does not establish the exact hardware mechanism. Lock-placement and direct
CPU1 RPMsg probes therefore run only with
`CONFIG_TESTS_BK7258_NATIVE_TRANSPORT`, never in the acceptance or product
profile. No OpenAMP or NuttX upstream source was patched.

Both AP profiles use
`CONFIG_SMP_DEFAULT_CPUSET=0x1`, so ordinary product tasks inherit CPU0 unless

text: The user hasn't heard from you in a while. As you continue, keep them updated when there's something to tell — a finding, a change of plan.

The board can already install 傻妞 apps, but nothing installs on the shipped firmware yet. So I'd harden the install path first and then make apps worth installing, rather than adding new mechanisms.

## What already exists

- **Install pipeline:** the phone sends a signed JSON package over the existing control session. The board checks the signature and the ELF (`bk7258_native_apps.c`), then stores it under `/cpdata/shaniu/native-apps`. Supported operations are trust, install, uninstall, start and stop.
- **Limits:** up to 4 apps, 16 KiB per image, 24 KiB per package. All loader and manager work is held on CPU0, because CPU1 file and RPMsg work still runs into the cross-core lock problem.
- **What an app can do (ABI v1):** an app is a cooperative `start` and `step` pair, stepped every 100 ms. Its only output is one of 3 expressions plus a progress value, and it can't import anything. The one example is `breathing.c`.
- **Blocker:** the publisher fingerprint in the normal build is deliberately empty, so the product firmware refuses every install. That is intentional; no test signing key was promoted.

## What I'd add, in priority order

**1. Unblock installs and make a bad app harmless**
- **Signing key (your decision):** you choose the publisher key and how its fingerprint gets onto the board (built into firmware, or an owner-approved trust operation). This is a trust decision, so it's yours.
- **Time limit per step:** `step()` runs inside the product event loop, so an app that loops forever would stall it. The board should time each step and abort the app if it overruns.
- **Auto-disable:** an app that faults or overruns twice gets disabled and never auto-starts. That protects boot.
- **Versions:** refuse downgrades per app, replace an installed app atomically, and show in the phone app why an install failed (signature, size, ABI or storage).

**2. ABI v2: let apps sense and respond**
Without this, every app is just another breathing animation.
- **Inputs:** a read-only event struct passed into `step()` carrying keys (K1/K3 only; K2 stays reserved), motion (moving, still, tilt), the NFC argument and the time.
- **Outputs:** requests that go through the existing rules, never straight to hardware: a haptic pulse (subject to the current cooldown and low-voltage limits), playing a built-in cue or local content ID, and an expression.
- **Saved state:** 256 B per app that survives reboot, for counters or high scores.
- **Permissions:** the package lists what it needs, the phone shows it at install, and the board refuses anything the app didn't declare. This matches how PC camera access already works.

**3. Ways to launch an app**
- **NFC:** add NFC action 7, "start app X with argument". This makes the scene cards much more useful and fits N2.
- **Voice:** a local intent such as "傻妞，开始 X" routed through the existing local-intent path, with no cloud needed.

**4. Developer loop**
- **Install from a PC:** an install command in `shaniu_gateway` over the native USB workbench (N3), so you don't need the phone for every try.
- **Host simulator:** run `start`/`step` on the PC and record the frames, giving host tests with no board needed.

**5. Example apps (pick two or three)**
- Shake to decide: motion triggers a random expression and a haptic pulse.
- Sit and water reminder: uses the timer and long stillness.
- Breathing or focus variants started from an NFC card.

The goal file puts more mini-games in a later, separate track, so I'd keep games out of this round.

My suggestion is **1, then 2 (inputs, haptic and cue outputs only), then the NFC part of 3, then one example app**. That gives a full install → permission → card-launch → feedback story on the real board.

Two things I need from you before writing code:
- Which publisher key should the product trust, and should its fingerprint be built into the firmware or set by an owner-approved trust operation on each device?
- Does this order work, or do you want something else first, such as the USB install path?
use your suggestion and develop

I'll go with that order: lifecycle hardening, then ABI v2, then NFC launch, then one example app. The signing-key decision stays open, so the publisher fingerprint stays empty and only host tests will use a test key. First I'll read the full manager and how the product uses it.

## First-party native feature packages

`native-app` builds separately compiled ARM ELF code. The example
`app/bk7258/native-apps/breathing.c` is deliberately absent from the base
firmware source list. `--source` accepts another independent C file using
`app/bk7258/bk7258_native_abi.h`; the default is the breathing exercise.

```bash
python3 tools/bk7258/bk7258.py native-app build --output /tmp/breathing.elf
python3 tools/bk7258/bk7258.py native-app pack \
  --source app/bk7258/native-apps/breathing.c \
  --id breathing --name '呼吸节奏' --description '按屏幕提示交替吸气和呼气' \
  --version 1 --signing-key /path/to/approved-publisher.pem \
  --output /tmp/breathing-package
python3 tools/bk7258/bk7258.py native-app catalog-entry \
  --package /tmp/breathing-package/package.json \
  --package-url https://your-store.example/breathing/package.json \
  --output /tmp/native-catalog.json
```

These commands neither generate identities nor publish/install anything.
`pack` exports `publisher.der`, the exact signed manifest, ELF and JSON package.
The approved public key's DER SHA-256 must be compiled into
`CONFIG_BK7258_NATIVE_PUBLISHER_SHA256`. Its default is empty: installation is
disabled until an approved publisher is configured. The phone cannot replace
this firmware trust root; it can supply only the matching public key, with no
native features installed. Do not use the upstream test signer in a product.

In the authenticated Android companion, open **原生功能**, import the matching
DER key, then import the package or configure an HTTPS catalog URL. Catalogs
use `shaniu.store/1` with `apps` entries containing `id`, `name`, `description`,
`version`, `package_url`, and the SHA-256 of the complete downloaded package.
There is no default hosted store. The phone checks format, size, metadata and
hash; the device performs the cryptographic signature verification. A catalog
is an HTTPS discovery document, not a separately signed trust authority.

p='tools/bk7258/README.md'
s=open(p).read()
old='''These commands neither generate identities nor publish/install anything.'''
new='''ABI 2 apps (for example `app/bk7258/native-apps/shake_decide.c`) receive
product motion-classifier events and may request one arbitrated haptic pulse
or a completion cue. Pack them with `--abi 2` and the canonical grant list,
for example `--permissions display,motion,haptic`; `display` is always first,
then any of `motion`, `haptic`, `sound` once each in that order. ABI 1 accepts
only `display`. `pack` also reports `app_hash`, the FNV-1a ID hash that an NFC
scene card (action 7) uses to start that app.

These commands neither generate identities nor publish/install anything.'''
assert old in s; open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))

p='docs/platforms/bk7258/shaniu-desktop-companion.md'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.rstrip('\n')+'''

## N4 原生功能 ABI 2 与刷卡启动

- 程序头沿用 `shaniu_native_entry`；`abi` 为 1 时只用原显示帧 `step`，为 2 时用
  `step2(state, elapsed, input, output)`。签名清单的 `abi` 必须与装载后的程序头一致，
  否则拒绝启动。权限首项固定为 `display`，其后按 `motion`、`haptic`、`sound`
  顺序各至多一次；ABI 1 只能声明 `display`。
- 输入：`events` 位为既有动作分类器的移动/稳定/倾斜候选，仅在持有 `motion` 的
  App 运行时投递，并由该 App 接管本次动作表情；`random` 为每步非密码学随机值。
  K1/K3 继续只调音量，K2 不交给 App。
- 输出：表情帧沿既有显示试用路径；`haptic` 为一次提示，经完成反馈同一组
  2 s 冷却、500 ms 动作静默、电压与电机故障门限，未准入即丢弃，不排队。
  `cue` 只在返回完成的那一步有效，卸载 App 后提交内容 ID 1；内容自身的
  采集/语音准入仍然生效。未声明权限的请求以 `-EPERM`、越界输出以 `-ERANGE`
  终止该次运行。
- 每次 `start`/`step` 计时，超过 20 ms 在返回后以 `-ETIMEDOUT` 终止；不能抢占
  永不返回的回调，此情形仍由既有 supervisor 处理。同一次开机内异常终止
  2 次后拒绝启动（`-EPERM`），重启或安装更高版本后恢复；准入撤销和用户停止
  不计异常。计数只在内存中，持久记录格式不变，回滚到旧固件仍可读取。
- NFC 场景动作 7：参数为 `FNV-1a(App ID) << 32 | 秒数`，秒数 0 表示 App 默认
  60 s，上限 3600。NFC worker 只写一个意图槽；产品循环在准入时于 CPU0 取出，
  按唯一哈希启动已安装 App。待发超过 2 s 以 `-ETIMEDOUT` 失败；已有 App 运行
  时为 `-EBUSY`。NCA2 phase 2 表示 App 已启动，不表示运行结束。
- 发布者公钥指纹仍为空，正式固件在配置获批第一方公钥前不接受安装；主机
  测试使用上游测试密钥，不作为产品身份。
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

All four parts are in place and pass their host tests, but none of it has been on the board yet, and installs stay disabled until you pick a signing key.

**What's new**
- **Fault protection:** the board times every app callback and stops an app that takes over 20 ms in one step. It also stops an app that asks for something it didn't declare or sends an invalid output. After 2 such failures in one boot, the app is refused until a reboot or a newer version is installed. Being pre-empted by voice or OTA, or stopped by the user, doesn't count. A callback that never returns still can't be interrupted; only the existing supervisor can deal with that.
- **ABI v2:**
  - Apps can now receive motion events (moved, settled, tilted) plus a random number each step.
  - Apps can request a short vibration. It goes through the same cooldown, battery and motor checks as task-completion feedback, and is dropped rather than queued.
  - Apps can request the built-in rhythm sound, but only when they finish.
  - Each package must declare these permissions, and the board enforces them.
  - Older ABI 1 apps load unchanged.
  - K1/K3 still control volume and are not passed to apps.
- **NFC action 7:** a card can start an installed app for a chosen number of seconds. The phone computes the same hash of the app ID as the board, and the board starts the app from its main loop.
- **Example app:** `app/bk7258/native-apps/shake_decide.c` shows a thinking face. When you move the board it shows a happy (yes) or neutral (no) face and requests a pulse. It builds to 1,536 bytes with no imports.
- **Phone app:** shows the requested permissions before install. Shows fault counts and the reason for the last stop. Adds a "启动原生功能" option for NFC cards.
- **Tooling and docs:** the packer takes `--abi 2 --permissions …` and prints the app's hash. I added an N4 section to the behaviour contract (`shaniu-desktop-companion.md`) and updated the CLI README.

**Test results**
- The native-app host test passes, including the new cases for ABI v2, permissions, faults, the time limit and card launch.
- The new intent-queue test passes. The packer tests pass (6/6).
- All 58 runs of the affected NFC, local-content and companion tests still pass.
- The Android unit tests pass: 6/6 for the native store and 19/19 for the NFC controller.
- An unsigned diagnostic build of the AIDK firmware succeeded with no warnings, and the new functions are present in the AP image. That proves it compiles, not that it works on the board.

**Not done**
- **Board testing:** nothing was flashed. Still unchecked: motion events reaching an app, whether the pulse is felt, starting an app from a card, and the 20 ms limit at real CPU speed.
- **Signing key (your decision):** `CONFIG_BK7258_NATIVE_PUBLISHER_SHA256` is still empty, so the product firmware refuses all installs. The host tests use a public mbedTLS test key, which must not be used in the product.
- **Phone UI:** the new screens haven't been tried on the phone.
- **Make build:** the older Make build doesn't list native apps at all, which was already true before this work. CMake is the build that matters.

# 2026-11-02 原生功能 ABI 3 实板验证清单（待执行）

本文件是交给实板操作方的检查清单，不是验收记录。实板结果请另建日期化记录，
状态汇总仍只写入 `boards/bk7258/CONFIGS.md`。行为合同见
[桌面伙伴合同 N5](../../platforms/bk7258/shaniu-desktop-companion.md#n5-语音启动定时与保存进度abi-3)。

## 开发侧已完成的检查

| 检查 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `make -C tests/host/bk7258 native_apps` | 通过：ABI 1/2 回归、ABI 3 结果/时钟/保存进度/定时/目录 |
| `make -C tests/host/bk7258 run-native-intent` | 通过：意图种类与窗口、目录快照、本地语句、动作 7 |
| `python3 tests/host/bk7258/test_native_app_package.py` | 7/7 |
| NFC/本地内容/companion 相关 58 个回归用例、`test_local_content.py`、`test_shaniu_local_intent` | 通过 |
| Android `NativeFeatureStoreTest` 7、`NfcBindingControllerTest` 19、`AgentDataControllerTest` 11 | 通过 |
| `bk7258.py build --board aidk_ai_toy --boot direct` | 通过，改动文件零警告；仅证明可编译 |
| `gcc -fanalyzer` 于 `bk7258_native_apps.c`、`bk7258_native_intent.c` | 无告警 |
| 三个 ABI 3 示例交叉编译 | 均无外部符号，约 1.5 KB，仅 `R_ARM_ABS32` |

## 前置条件

1. 按现行 SOP 构建并下载正常 `openvela_ap` 候选（正式签名链），发布者指纹沿用
   上一轮实板所用的已批准配置；不要使用本清单生成任何密钥。
2. 设备已认领、控制已绑定、Wi-Fi 可用；`clock_valid` 需为 true（网络时间或手机
   下发时间，6 小时内）。
3. 手机安装本轮 Android 构建（含 ABI 3、定时显示与 8191 B 回读上限）。
4. 用已批准签名打包（版本号须大于设备上已有同 ID 版本）：

```bash
python3 tools/bk7258/bk7258.py native-app pack --source app/bk7258/native-apps/shake_decide.c \
  --id shake --name 摇一摇做决定 --description 摇一摇给出去或不去 --version <N> \
  --abi 3 --permissions display,motion,haptic --results 去吧,再想想 \
  --signing-key <approved.pem> --output <out>/shake
python3 tools/bk7258/bk7258.py native-app pack --source app/bk7258/native-apps/nudge.c \
  --id nudge --name 喝水提醒 --description 到点提醒，拿起即完成 --version 1 \
  --abi 3 --permissions display,motion,haptic,clock,storage --results 完成,错过 \
  --signing-key <approved.pem> --output <out>/nudge
python3 tools/bk7258/bk7258.py native-app pack --source app/bk7258/native-apps/sit_reminder.c \
  --id sit --name 久坐提醒 --description 久坐不动时提醒起身 --version 1 \
  --abi 3 --permissions display,motion,haptic --results 起来了,还没动,一直在活动 \
  --signing-key <approved.pem> --output <out>/sit
```

记录每个包的 `image_sha256`、`package_size`、`app_hash`。

## 用例

每项保留串口原文与手机截图。“日志”列为应出现的关键行。

| ID | 步骤 | 预期 / 日志 |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | 回归：已装 ABI 1/2 功能从手机启动、停止；NFC 动作 7 卡片启动 | 行为同上一轮；`BKNATIVE intent=… kind=1 result=0` |
| I1 | 手机安装三个 ABI 3 包 | 确认框列出权限中文名；回读 `abi:3`、`results` 标签；`abi_max:3` |
| I2 | 安装一个 ABI 3 包后卸载再装同版本 | 卸载成功；重新安装成功（新记录） |
| V1 | 说“傻妞，帮我做个决定” | `BKLOCAL … kind=app result=0 … llm=0 tts=0`；交互结束后 `BKNATIVE intent=N kind=1 result=0`；思考表情 |
| V2 | V1 后摇动设备 | 开心或中性表情约 3 s + 一次短振动（受 2 s 冷却）；随后结束；手机显示“上次结果（shake）：去吧/再想想” |
| V3 | V1 后不动直到超时（默认 60 s） | 结束，`last_value` 为 0，无结果标签 |
| V4 | 说“傻妞，打开喝水提醒” | 本地语句命中 nudge；交互结束后启动 |
| V5 | 说“傻妞，启动摇一摇做决定，给我二十秒” | 走 LLM：`BKVOICE device tool=device_app result=0`；20 s 等待窗口 |
| V6 | 说“傻妞，刚才的结果是什么” | 工具 `list` 返回 `last_result` 标签，回答与 V2 一致；不得在启动当轮编造结果 |
| V7 | App 运行时说“傻妞，停止喝水提醒” | 语音开始即中止 App（`last_result` -125）；工具返回 `not_running`，回答不报错 |
| V8 | 说“傻妞，不要打开喝水提醒” / “能帮我做个决定吗？” | 不命中本地语句，交由 Agent；不得启动 App |
| C1 | 手机回读 | `clock_valid:true`；断网超过 6 小时或未同步时为 false |
| S1 | 说“傻妞，每天 HH:MM 提醒我喝水”（取 2–3 分钟后） | `device_app schedule` 成功；手机显示该定时“每天 喝水提醒 · 尚未到时” |
| S2 | 到点保持安静 | `BKNATIVE schedule slot=… minute=… result=0`；开心表情 + 振动，每 20 s 至多 3 次；拿起即结束，结果“完成” |
| S3 | 再设一条 2 分钟后的定时，到点那一整分钟持续说话 | 记录一次 `result=-16`；之后不补发；手机显示“上次已跳过” |
| S4 | 设定后复位设备 | 定时仍在；到点仍能触发（触发记录不跨重启） |
| S5 | 核对时区 | 触发时刻与北京时间一致 |
| S6 | 说“傻妞，取消喝水提醒的定时” | `unschedule` 成功；回读不再显示 |
| P1 | nudge 两次完成；若有 nsh，`ls /cpdata/shaniu/native-apps/state-nudge` | 存在 `config.bin`；复位后再完成仍成功 |
| P2 | 卸载 nudge | `state-nudge` 目录被删除 |
| T1 | 说“傻妞，启动久坐提醒，六十秒”，之后保持设备静止 | 约 60 s 后开心表情 + 振动；移动后结束，结果“起来了” |
| T2 | 观察全程日志 | 无 `-110`（单步超时）、无 supervisor fault/recovery 增加 |
| B1 | 四个功能 + 定时全部装满后手机回读 | 回读成功（≤ 8191 B），无 `-28` |

## 判定与边界

- 主机测试不能证明动作识别率、振动体感、语音交互时序或时间同步可靠性，以上
  均以实板为准。
- App 不是后台服务：任何语音交互、OTA、专注/任务界面都会中止正在运行的 App，
  久坐提醒因此可能被中断，属合同内行为。
- 设备无主动语音播报；结果只在表情、手机与下一轮工具查询中可见。

I've implemented features 1 → 3 in order, and every host test, Android unit test and the AIDK firmware build passes. Nothing has run on a board yet, and nothing is committed or flashed. The real-board checklist for Codex is at `docs/verification/bk7258/2026-11-02-native-abi3-hil-checklist.md`.

One correction to what I said before we started: 傻妞 can't speak an app's result. The board has no way to talk unprompted without starting a cloud TTS turn. The result shows on the eyes and on the phone, and 傻妞 can read it out on the next voice turn.

## What was built

**1. Start apps by voice, with a result**
- New agent tool `device_app` with five actions: list, start, stop, schedule, unschedule. The built-in skill text explains when to use it.
- Spoken phrases handled on the board, with no LLM or TTS:
  - "帮我做个决定" (and similar) starts the app with ID `shake`.
  - "启动/打开/开始" + an installed app's exact name starts that app.
  - These are matched after the existing focus/volume/eyes/stop phrases, so an app name can't override them. Questions, negations and conditionals are rejected, as before.
- Apps can return a result (1–4) whose labels come from the signed package.
- Apps only run while voice is idle, so a spoken start waits up to 30 s for the reply to finish. When the tool returns, the app hasn't started yet and the result is unknown; the skill text tells the agent this.
- When you say "stop", the voice turn itself has usually stopped the app already. The tool reports that as "not running", not as an error.
- Voice, card and tool requests all go through the same request slot. The product loop applies them on CPU0, because the app manager refuses calls from other CPUs.

**2. Clock and schedule**
- Apps can read the local minute and day. Local time is network/phone time plus `CONFIG_BK7258_NATIVE_UTC_OFFSET_MINUTES`, which defaults to 480 (UTC+8, no daylight saving).
- Up to 4 scheduled starts, stored on the board and kept across reboots.
- If voice or another app is busy at the scheduled minute, the board keeps trying for that whole minute. If it never gets a chance, that day's start is skipped, not queued.
- Schedules run whenever the device is claimed and activated; the phone doesn't need to be connected.
- New example apps: `nudge.c` (reminder: pick it up to complete it) and `sit_reminder.c` (nudges after a period of stillness).

**3. Saved progress (up to 32 bytes per app)**
- Written only when the app finishes cleanly and the data changed, as one atomic write in a separate directory per app.
- If loading fails, the app doesn't start. If saving fails, the error is reported but doesn't count as an app fault.
- Updating an app keeps its data; uninstalling deletes it.
- `nudge` uses this to keep today's count and a daily streak.

**Compatibility**
- All of this is a new ABI 3. The ABI 1 and ABI 2 types are unchanged, and the verified ABI 2 behaviour is covered by tests against a frozen copy of the old shake app.
- Older firmware refuses ABI 3 packages at install time.
- The existing app record format didn't change, so rolling back firmware is still safe.
- `shake_decide.c` is now ABI 3. It finishes 3 s after its first answer and reports yes/no as the result.

## Files
- **Board code:** `bk7258_native_abi.h`, `bk7258_native_loader.c`, `bk7258_native_apps.c/.h`, `bk7258_native_intent.c/.h`, new `bk7258_agent_native_tool.inc`, `bk7258_agent_product.c`, `bk7258_agent_local_intent.inc`, `Kconfig`.
- **Apps:** `native-apps/shake_decide.c`, new `nudge.c` and `sit_reminder.c`.
- **Board config:** the timezone offset added to the AIDK `openvela_ap` and `openvela_ap_native_test` defconfigs.
- **Tooling:** `native_apps.py` gains `--abi 3` and `--results`.
- **Tests:** the native-app and intent host tests, the packer test, and the host `Makefile`.
- **Android:** `NativeFeatureStore.kt`, `MainActivity.kt` (shows the last result and the schedule), `AgentDataController.kt` and its tests. The native-app readback limit went from 4095 to 8191 bytes on both board and phone, because four apps with full labels and schedules could exceed 4 KB. A phone without this build only fails in that worst case.
- **Docs:** new N5 section in `shaniu-desktop-companion.md`, the CLI README, and the board checklist.

## Checks run
- **Host tests:** the native-app test covers ABI 1/2 regression plus ABI 3 results, clock, saved progress (including a failed save) and the schedule. The intent test passes. Packer tests 7/7. All 58 NFC/content/companion runs, `test_local_content.py` and the local-phrase parser test still pass.
- **Android:** NativeFeatureStore 7/7, NfcBinding 19/19, AgentData 11/11; `MainActivity` compiles.
- **Firmware:** unsigned diagnostic build for `aidk_ai_toy` passes, with no warnings from the files I changed. The new functions and the tool are in the AP image. This only proves it compiles.
- **Static analysis:** `gcc -fanalyzer` is clean on the manager and the intent module.
- **Example apps:** all three cross-compile at about 1.5 KB with no imports.
- **Self-review fixes:** a cleanup that freed objects owned elsewhere, a stale-request check that could swallow unrelated speech, a schedule that skipped after a single busy tick, and the readback size limit.

## Known limitations
- Any voice turn, OTA or focus screen stops a running app, so the sit reminder can be interrupted. Apps are not background services.
- If the user keeps talking for more than 30 s after a spoken start, the start expires.
- Schedules don't carry over a reboot within the same minute, don't catch up on missed starts, and use a fixed timezone offset.
- Saved progress has no phone screen yet; check it by voice or on the board itself.
- Two existing problems I didn't change:
  - `test_pc_product_route.py` looks for a line that the PC-approval work changed earlier.
  - `bk7258_display_focus.inc:40` has a format warning.

## For Codex
The checklist has the pack commands with exact permissions and labels, and 24 cases:
- Regression of ABI 1/2 apps and NFC cards.
- Voice start, results, stop, and phrases that must not trigger.
- Clock validity, timezone, scheduled start, skip, persistence across reboot, and cancel.
- Saved progress and the sit reminder.
- No step timeouts or supervisor faults, and a full-capacity phone readback.

Two inputs are needed:
- The approved signing key (the same one Codex used in the last board run).
- Trusted device time, so the schedule cases can run.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Native-app platform: signed JSON package (`shaniu.native/1`), ELF ET_REL loaded on CPU0 only (`bknative_require_cpu0`), cooperative `start`/`step` stepped every 100 ms.
   - Manager limits: 4 apps, 16 KiB image, record kept in `bkprov_store` at `/cpdata/shaniu/native-apps`.
   - ABI 1: display frames only.
   - ABI 2: input events (moved/settled/tilted) plus random; output haptic and cue; permissions `display,motion,haptic,sound`.
   - ABI 3:
     - `bknative_input3_s` adds `minute_of_day` and `day`.
     - `bknative_output3_s` adds `result` (0..4) and `reserved`.
     - Program header gains a trailing `saved_size` (0..32).
     - New permissions `clock` and `storage`.
     - Optional manifest field `results` (1–4 labels, each ≤16 bytes).
     - Older firmware rejects ABI 3 at install.
   - Fault rules: 20 ms callback budget (`-ETIMEDOUT`); 2 faults per boot blocks the app (`-EPERM`), stored in RAM only. Admission loss and user stop are not faults.
   - Intent slot (spinlock, metadata only):
     - Kinds: START, STOP, SCHEDULE_SET, SCHEDULE_CLEAR.
     - Pending window: card 2 s, voice 30 s.
     - START requires app admission; the other kinds require control admission only.
     - The product loop applies requests on CPU0.
   - Catalog snapshot (`bknative_catalog_s`, about 1 KB) is published by the manager so the agent thread can read app facts.
   - App hash is FNV-1a of the app ID; `shake` = `0xbd8bb2f5`.
   - Admission: apps run only while voice is idle, so a voice start begins after the reply ends. There is no proactive TTS; results are shown on the eyes, in the phone app, and via the tool on the next turn.
   - `g_control_bound` means owner control handlers are bound (device claimed), not that a phone is connected.
   - Time: `bkprov_time_get(0,&utc)` is non-blocking. Local time = UTC + `CONFIG_BK7258_NATIVE_UTC_OFFSET_MINUTES` (default 480).
   - Schedule:
     - At most 4 entries, keyed by (app hash, minute).
     - Retried throughout its minute; if never admitted, recorded as `-EBUSY` (skipped).
     - At most one attempt per day; `fired_day` is kept in RAM only.
     - Persisted in `native-apps/schedule/` via `bkprov_store` (JSON of 4 entries `[hash,minute,days,seconds]`).
   - Saved state: stored at `native-apps/state-<id>/config.bin` as record `"NSV1"` + data.
     - Loaded before `start`; written only on clean completion when it changed.
     - A load failure refuses the start; a save failure is reported but not counted as a fault.
     - Kept across updates; deleted on uninstall.
